title: Objects Dropped in Inlet/Storm Drain - Hazardous
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report objects dropped in the inlet or storm drain. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.
instructions: Call 311 to report objects dropped in an inlet or storm drain. This request must be dispatched.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about an object dropped into an inlet or storm drain.
actions.why: For an object dropped into an inlet or storm drain. The request must be dispatched and the saved instructions direct people to call 311.
